intent: Implement the separately admitted exact-principal selection seam in the dharmagraph-owned Orchestrator. Before topology heuristics or fallback, a task carrying typed campaign authority must resolve the nested claimed_principal to exactly one currently idle AgentState ID; zero or multiple matches return no dispatch and never reach assignment or provider execution. Tasks without campaign authority retain the existing generic selection path.

interface_mismatches: Preferred names and roles are advisory and eventually fall back to another idle agent; authenticated campaign authority cannot be represented as a preference.
The owner adapter requires exactly one PIPELINE dispatch, so an unavailable exact principal must return no dispatch before _assign_dispatch rather than substituting a different seat.
Generic routing is a shared dharmagraph surface and must remain behaviorally unchanged when mission_campaign_authority is absent.
honest_blockers: Exact selection proves only the AgentState ID passed into the existing owner pipeline; it does not prove the runner remains live, a provider is called, output is useful, or acceptance occurs.
This packet does not parse manifests, bind task metadata, create or validate execution leases, choose model/provider routes, or mutate campaign control state.
A busy, missing, malformed, or duplicated exact principal returns no dispatch even when another agent is idle.
The exact campaign path is conditional; every task without the typed campaign authority key retains generic selection behavior.
The organism packet separately enforces returned OwnerExecutionRef.agent_id equality as a postcondition defense.
session_entry.rollback: Revert this exact two-file implementation and its packet. Generic routing remains the pre-existing behavior; campaign tasks must then remain stopped because preferred-agent fallback is not authenticated authority. No task, lease, provider, process, transport, model account, merge, deployment, or external system is mutated by code rollback itself.
